framing: UTF-8 domain + LF, then each field as UTF-8-byte-length + ':' + exact-value + ';'

worker_statement.worker_statement_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact worker statement

worker_receipt_wire.rule: serialize once after RSA-PSS signing, persist exact UTF-8 bytes, and return the same bytes for every retry
worker_receipt_wire.worker_receipt_wire_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact persisted signed Worker receipt bytes; this digest is not a field of the Worker receipt

journal_payload.canonicalization: strict UTF-8 JSON object with properties ordered by ordinal name, no insignificant whitespace
journal_payload.rule: the Worker appends the exact persisted wire digest; Journal treats it as opaque durable data and signs it in the independent rich attestation

verification_rule: verify the Worker signature, exact active drain and scope, exact worker and Journal artifacts, Release BOM, protected policy, routing epoch, bounded freshness and zero in-flight work; then independently verify and correlate the raw edge.journal.drain.attestation/v1 wire by exact worker_receipt_wire_sha256 before cutover or rollback
